text:
carmen_sales: Acme asked for a Private POC with PrivateLink only. Can we produce a one-page onboarding checklist they can follow?

leo_se: Short checklist from SE:
- Provide VPC ID + CIDR and confirm no overlap with our infra (we use 10.220.0.0/16).
- Share 1 private subnet ID per AZ to host endpoint ENIs (prefer /24 or larger).
- Create interface endpoint using our service name (we'll send svc string) and share VPCE IDs.
- Enable Private DNS on VPCE or add Route53 A records pointing to ENI IPs.

harpreet_netops: Minimal networking rules:
- SG on endpoint ENIs: inbound TCP 443 from app subnets, inbound TCP 15001 from healthcheck subnets; outbound TCP 443 to our control-plane CIDRs.
- NACLs: allow ephemeral ports 1024-65535 outbound; allow inbound 443.
- Hint: avoid /28 subnets for VPCE ENIs — they often run out of IPs.

zoe_sre: Security & acceptance notes:
- We'll set service to require acceptance. Customer sends VPCE ID, we review and accept.
- Ask them to tag resources with `redwood:pocteam=acme` for quick lookup.
- If they have strict corporate proxy or Host header rewriting, ask them to test from an EC2 inside VPC and paste curl output.

leo_se: Quick test command to validate DNS after acceptance:
```
curl -v --resolve api.redwood.internal:443:10.0.4.23 https://api.redwood.internal/health
```
Replace IP with the VPCE ENI private IP.

carmen_sales: Pricing note for customer: Dedicated-managed reserved pool tends to be lower friction for short trials; Private (self-hosted) requires infra + license. I'll ask which they prefer and loop in sales-ops for numbers.

harpreet_netops: If they later want TGW instead, we can support cross-account TGW attachments but that requires IAM role + attachment acceptance steps. For now PrivateLink-only is fine.

carmen_sales: Great, I'll send this checklist and our svc name. Will post VPCE IDs here when Acme creates them. :thumbsup:
